## Clean data

```{r}
#| label: extract data

expression <- Biobase::exprs(GSE24504_raw)
# columns ("GSM60...") = samples (one sample of one organ of one mouse after one time)
# rows (1 to 22680) = number of microarray probe
# values = normalized log2 ratio Cy3/Cy5 (test/reference)

samples <- Biobase::pData(GSE24504_raw)
# description of the samples

probes <- Biobase::fData(GSE24504_raw)


```

```{r}
#| label: new dataframe

samples_clean <- samples |> 
  select(title, 
         geo_accession, 
         source_name_ch1, 
         `mouse:ch1`,
         `timepoint:ch1`,
         `tissue:ch1`) |> 
  rename(mouse = `mouse:ch1`,
         timepoint = `timepoint:ch1`,
         tissue = `tissue:ch1`)


expression_flip <- expression |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  t() |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  rownames_to_column("geo_accession")
  

dat_clean <- full_join(samples_clean, expression_flip, by = "geo_accession")
```

```{r}
expression_long <- expression |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("ma_probe") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -ma_probe, 
               names_to = "geo_accession", 
               values_to = "expression")

dat_clean_long <- full_join(samples_clean, expression_long, by = "geo_accession")



```

```{r}

{r}
#| label: first overviews

dat_clean |> 
  filter(tissue == "muscle") |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = timepoint, y = `1`)) +
  geom_point()
         

dat_clean_long |> 
  filter(tissue == "muscle") |> 
  filter(ma_probe == "1" | ma_probe == "2" | ma_probe == "3") |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = timepoint, y = expression,
                       colour = ma_probe)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

```
